<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Eternal Torch](/Feats.aspx?ID=4237) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 28

</column>

---

You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow. You create a magical, [torch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=60)-like flame within 120 feet in any color you choose. It's as bright and hot as a torch. You can have it orbit a target willing creature or emit from a target object that's unattended or attended by a willing creature. If you create a flame on a weapon, you still need to use it as an [improvised weapon](/Rules.aspx?ID=224) to attack with the flame, just as with a torch.

 The flame has an unlimited duration. You can have a maximum number of Eternal Torches equal to your Constitution modifier, and you can Dismiss each torch individually.

---
**Level (8th)** All your torches—even ones you already created— shed [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) in a 60-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 60 feet).
name: Eternal Torch
